name: SalnetHub Knowledge Base
description: Everything published on www.salnethub.com about SalnetHub: company, services, pricing, process, integrations, FAQs and policies. One self-contained document per topic, for retrieval by the SalnetHub chat assistant.

documents.title: About SalnetHub
documents.content:
SalnetHub: Systems that run your business while you grow it.
SalnetHub is an automation and AI company for small-to-medium teams and businesses. We build the connections between your tools so work moves on its own.
Business automation and AI agents for small businesses. We automate lead follow-up, CRM updates, reporting and admin across the tools you already use.
We design and build automations and AI agents across your whole operation: sales, marketing, admin, finance, reporting and customer support. Your tools finally work as one system, and your team gets back to the work that moves the business forward.

Most teams do not need more software. They need the software they have to work together.

A typical small-to-medium business runs on 10 to 30 tools: a CRM, Google Workspace, accounting, a project board, forms, chat. Each one works well on its own. The trouble is the space between them, where people copy data, chase updates and rebuild the same report every week.

That is where SalnetHub works. We map how your work actually happens, then connect your tools so information moves on its own. Where judgment is needed, we add AI that works from your data and keeps a person in control.

Automation is our core. We also build websites and AI assistants, because they work best when they are part of the same connected system.

Our line: Smarter systems. Better decisions. Greater impact.

Founder: Bwire Solomon, Founder of SalnetHub. Solomon has built automations, CRM workflows and AI agents for 53 client projects since 2023, mostly for small teams running on Google Workspace, HubSpot, Zoho, Make, Zapier and n8n.
Track record: 53 client projects since 2023.
Based in: Kampala, Uganda. SalnetHub works with clients worldwide, remotely.
Website: https://www.salnethub.com
Email: info@salnethub.com

documents.title: What SalnetHub believes and how we behave
documents.content:
What SalnetHub believes:
- Your team should spend its time on work that needs a person.
- Automation should use the tools you already pay for.
- Every system we build should be documented and owned by you.
- AI should answer from your data, with a person in control.

How we behave. Four principles shape how SalnetHub writes, builds and supports:
- Plain: We describe your system in the words you already use. If a term needs a definition, we use a simpler one.
- Specific: We name the tools, the steps and the time saved. A number does more work than an adjective.
- Calm: Automations break sometimes. We say what happened, what we did and what happens next, without drama.
- Accountable: We own our work. When something is our mistake, we say so in the first sentence.

documents.title: Who SalnetHub works with
documents.content:
SalnetHub works with small-to-medium teams and businesses, usually between 5 and 200 people, that have outgrown doing everything by hand. If your team copies data between tools, we can probably help.

- Service businesses: Agencies, consultancies, accounting and legal practices where client admin eats billable hours.
- E-commerce and retail: Online stores and wholesalers handling orders, stock and customer messages across several tools.
- Property and logistics: Teams coordinating bookings, maintenance, quotes and documents with many moving parts.
- Growing sales teams: Teams of 3 to 50 reps who need leads routed, followed up and reported without extra admin.

documents.title: Contact SalnetHub and book a call
documents.content:
The best way to start with SalnetHub is a free 20-minute discovery call on Google Meet. Book it at https://www.salnethub.com/contact#book.

What happens:
1. Pick a time that suits you. Times show in your own time zone.
2. We look at your workflow: your tools and process, and the first workflow worth automating.
3. A pilot plan. If it is a fit, you get a clear target, a 14-day pilot and a price based on your own numbers, in writing. No obligation.

Booking details: calls are offered Monday to Friday, 09:00 to 17:00 East Africa Time (EAT, UTC+3), with at least 12 hours' notice and up to 21 days ahead. You get a Google Meet link and a calendar invite by email straight away.

Prefer to write first? Use the contact form at https://www.salnethub.com/contact or email info@salnethub.com. SalnetHub replies within 1 business day.

documents.title: Marketing & CRM automation: overview and price
documents.content:
SalnetHub service: Marketing & CRM automation (Automation).
Keep your CRM accurate and your follow-ups on time without anyone updating records by hand.
A CRM that updates itself. We connect your forms, inbox, ads and CRM so every contact, deal and follow-up is recorded the moment it happens.

Where CRM work usually breaks:
- Records go stale: Sales reps update the CRM at the end of the week, if at all. Reports are only as good as the last manual entry.
- Follow-ups slip: A lead fills in a form on Friday evening and hears back on Tuesday. By then they have spoken to two competitors.
- Marketing and sales disagree: Campaign data sits in one tool and deal data in another, so nobody can say which channel brings paying customers.

Example: inbound enquiries for a 12-person services firm
Before: Enquiries landed in a shared inbox. Someone copied them into HubSpot twice a day and replies took 6 to 24 hours.
After: Every enquiry creates a HubSpot contact and deal, gets a personal reply within 2 minutes and a task for the right rep.

How you pay for Marketing & CRM automation: Pay from savings. Priced on time saved: your monthly fee is never more than 25% of what the work costs you today. Starts with a $250 pilot, refunded if it misses its target.

documents.title: Marketing & CRM automation: what is included and how it is delivered
documents.content:
What SalnetHub's Marketing & CRM automation service includes:
- Contact sync: Form fills, calls, emails and purchases create or update the right CRM record with no duplicates.
- Follow-up sequences: Personal emails and tasks go out on a schedule you set, and stop as soon as the lead replies.
- Deal stage automation: Deals move stage when something real happens: a quote is opened, a contract is signed, an invoice is paid.
- Lifecycle tagging: Contacts are tagged by source, interest and stage so campaigns reach the right people.
- Campaign attribution: UTM and ad data are stored on the contact, so revenue can be traced back to the channel that earned it.
- Clean-up jobs: Scheduled checks merge duplicates, fix formatting and flag records with missing owners.

From first touch to closed deal: Each step runs on its own. Your team only steps in for the conversations that need a person.
Steps: Web form (New enquiry) → CRM record (Created, deduplicated) → Follow-up email (Sent in 2 minutes) → Sales task (Assigned to owner) → Deal updated (Stage moves on reply)

Deliverables:
- A map of your current contact and deal flow, with the gaps marked
- Working automations in your CRM and connected tools
- Field and pipeline clean-up so the data stays usable
- A written handover guide and a recorded walkthrough
- 30 days of monitoring and fixes after launch

Timeline:
- Map (Week 1): We review your CRM, forms and inbox and agree which flows to automate first.
- Build (Weeks 2 to 3): We build in a test copy of your setup so nothing touches live data until it works.
- Test (Week 3): We run real examples end to end with your team and fix what they find.
- Launch (Week 4): We switch it on, watch the first days closely and hand over the documentation.

Tools we typically use for Marketing & CRM automation: HubSpot, Zoho, Gmail, Google Sheets, Typeform, Mailchimp, Make, Zapier.

documents.title: Lead acquisition & qualification: overview and price
documents.content:
SalnetHub service: Lead acquisition & qualification (Automation).
Capture every lead, score it, and route the good ones to the right person in minutes.
Every lead captured, scored and routed. Leads from forms, ads and chat are enriched, scored against your criteria and sent to the right rep before they go cold.

Why good leads get lost:
- Too many sources: Website forms, Facebook lead ads, LinkedIn, referrals and chat all land in different places.
- No clear priority: Reps treat a student enquiry and a 200-seat buyer the same way, so the best leads wait in line.
- Slow first response: Most buyers choose the company that replies first. A reply the next day is often too late.

Example: lead ads for a home-services company
Before: Facebook leads were downloaded as a spreadsheet each morning and split between 4 reps by hand.
After: Each lead is scored and texted to the rep covering that area within 90 seconds, with a booking link sent to the customer.

How you pay for Lead acquisition & qualification: Pay per lead. Paid per qualified lead we deliver. No setup fee, nothing up front. Starts with a free 14-day pilot.

documents.title: Lead acquisition & qualification: what is included and how it is delivered
documents.content:
What SalnetHub's Lead acquisition & qualification service includes:
- Lead capture: Forms, ad platforms, chat and email feed into one pipeline with the source recorded.
- Enrichment: Company size, industry and location are added from public data so reps know who they are talking to.
- Scoring: Each lead is scored against rules you agree with us, such as budget, team size or service requested.
- Routing: Leads go to the right rep by territory, product or round robin, with a backup if nobody picks them up.
- Instant replies: A personal first reply and a booking link go out within 2 minutes, day or night.
- Disqualification: Poor-fit leads get a polite automated reply and stay out of your reps' queue.

From click to qualified conversation: A strong lead reaches a rep's phone in minutes. A weak one never takes up their time.
Steps: Lead captured (Form, ad or chat) → Enriched (Company data added) → Scored (Against your rules) → Routed (Right rep, instantly) → Call booked (Calendar link sent)

Deliverables:
- A lead scoring model written down and agreed with your sales lead
- Connected capture from every lead source you use
- Routing rules, reply templates and booking links
- A live view of lead volume, speed to reply and conversion
- Handover guide and 30 days of monitoring

Timeline:
- Map (Week 1): We list every lead source and agree what makes a lead worth a call.
- Build (Weeks 2 to 3): We connect the sources, scoring, routing and replies in a test setup.
- Test (Week 3): We push sample leads through every path, including the edge cases.
- Launch (Week 4): We go live and tune the scoring after the first 2 weeks of real leads.

Tools we typically use for Lead acquisition & qualification: Typeform, Google Forms, Meta lead ads, HubSpot, Google Sheets, Calendly, WhatsApp, Make.

documents.title: Lead acquisition & qualification FAQ: Can you work with our ad accounts?
documents.content:
Question about SalnetHub's Lead acquisition & qualification service: Can you work with our ad accounts?
Answer: Yes. We connect Facebook and Instagram lead ads, Google Ads lead forms and most form tools through their official integrations.

documents.title: Lead acquisition & qualification FAQ: Who decides the scoring rules?
documents.content:
Question about SalnetHub's Lead acquisition & qualification service: Who decides the scoring rules?
Answer: You do. We propose a starting model from your past deals and adjust it with your sales lead.

documents.title: Lead acquisition & qualification FAQ: Can leads go to WhatsApp or SMS?
documents.content:
Question about SalnetHub's Lead acquisition & qualification service: Can leads go to WhatsApp or SMS?
Answer: Yes. Reps can be alerted by email, Slack-style chat, WhatsApp or SMS, depending on what your team actually checks.

documents.title: Lead acquisition & qualification FAQ: What if a rep does not respond?
documents.content:
Question about SalnetHub's Lead acquisition & qualification service: What if a rep does not respond?
Answer: We set a time limit. If the lead is not picked up, it moves to the next rep or a manager.

documents.title: Data reporting & analytics: overview and price
documents.content:
SalnetHub service: Data reporting & analytics (Automation).
Dashboards that update themselves, so the Monday report is ready before Monday.
Reports that build themselves. We pull data from your CRM, finance and operations tools into live dashboards and scheduled reports your team can trust.

What manual reporting costs you:
- Hours of copy and paste: Someone exports 5 spreadsheets every week and stitches them together before the meeting.
- Numbers nobody trusts: Different teams report different totals because each one pulls data a different way.
- Decisions on old data: By the time the monthly report is ready, the month it describes is long gone.

Example: weekly sales report for an online retailer
Before: The operations lead spent most of Monday morning exporting Shopify, ad and Sheets data into a slide deck.
After: A Looker Studio dashboard refreshes every hour, and a summary email reaches the leadership team at 8 am each Monday.

How you pay for Data reporting & analytics: Pay from savings. Priced on time saved: your monthly fee is never more than 25% of what the work costs you today. Starts with a $250 pilot, refunded if it misses its target.

documents.title: Data reporting & analytics: what is included and how it is delivered
documents.content:
What SalnetHub's Data reporting & analytics service includes:
- Data pipelines: Scheduled syncs pull from your CRM, accounting, ads, store and spreadsheets into one place.
- Live dashboards: Looker Studio or Google Sheets dashboards that refresh on their own, built around the questions you ask.
- Scheduled reports: A PDF or email summary goes to the right people every Monday at 8 am, or whenever you choose.
- KPI definitions: We write down how each number is calculated so every team reports the same total.
- Alerts: Get a message when a number crosses a line: cash below a threshold, leads down 30%, stock running low.
- Data clean-up: Duplicates, mismatched names and broken formats are fixed before they reach a chart.

From scattered exports to one source of truth: Data is collected, cleaned and charted on a schedule. Nobody has to open an export again.
Steps: CRM (Deals, contacts) → Accounting (Invoices, cash) → Store and ads (Orders, spend) → Clean and join (Every 15 minutes) → Dashboard (Live for the team)

Deliverables:
- A short list of the KPIs that matter, with written definitions
- Automated data pipelines from each source
- Dashboards and scheduled reports for each audience
- Threshold alerts for the numbers you want watched
- Handover guide and 30 days of monitoring

Timeline:
- Define (Week 1): We agree on the questions the dashboard must answer and how each number is calculated.
- Connect (Weeks 2 to 3): We build the data pipelines and check every total against your current reports.
- Design (Week 3): We lay out the dashboards so the most important number is the first thing you see.
- Launch (Week 4): We schedule the reports, set the alerts and walk your team through it.

Tools we typically use for Data reporting & analytics: Google Sheets, Looker Studio, Google Analytics, HubSpot, QuickBooks, Xero, Shopify, Apps Script.

documents.title: Data reporting & analytics FAQ: Do we need a data warehouse?
documents.content:
Question about SalnetHub's Data reporting & analytics service: Do we need a data warehouse?
Answer: Most small-to-medium businesses do not. Google Sheets and Looker Studio handle a lot. We suggest a warehouse only when your data volume needs one.

documents.title: Data reporting & analytics FAQ: How fresh is the data?
documents.content:
Question about SalnetHub's Data reporting & analytics service: How fresh is the data?
Answer: It depends on the source. Most dashboards refresh between every 15 minutes and every hour.

documents.title: Data reporting & analytics FAQ: Can you match our existing report?
documents.content:
Question about SalnetHub's Data reporting & analytics service: Can you match our existing report?
Answer: Yes. We start by rebuilding the report you already use, so you can check our numbers against it.

documents.title: Data reporting & analytics FAQ: Is our data shared with anyone?
documents.content:
Question about SalnetHub's Data reporting & analytics service: Is our data shared with anyone?
Answer: No. Your data stays in your own accounts. We work with the access you grant us and remove it when the project ends if you prefer.

documents.title: Business process automation: overview and price
documents.content:
SalnetHub service: Business process automation (Automation).
Automate approvals, invoicing, onboarding and other processes that cross teams and tools.
Processes that run end to end. We automate the multi-step processes that cross teams, like client onboarding, approvals and invoicing, with clear owners at every step.

Where cross-team processes stall:
- Work waits in inboxes: An approval sits in a manager's email for 3 days because nobody knew it was waiting.
- The same data typed 4 times: A new client's details are entered into the CRM, the invoicing tool, the project board and a spreadsheet.
- Steps depend on one person: When the person who knows the process is on leave, the process stops.

Example: client onboarding for an accounting practice
Before: Each new client took about 2 hours of admin across 5 tools, and steps were often missed.
After: A signed engagement letter triggers every setup step in under 5 minutes, with a checklist the partner can review.

How you pay for Business process automation: Pay from savings. Priced on time saved: your monthly fee is never more than 25% of what the work costs you today. Starts with a $250 pilot, refunded if it misses its target.

documents.title: Business process automation: what is included and how it is delivered
documents.content:
What SalnetHub's Business process automation service includes:
- Client onboarding: A signed contract creates the client folder, project board, invoice schedule and welcome email.
- Approvals: Requests go to the right approver with one-click approve or reject, plus reminders and escalation.
- Invoicing and payments: Invoices are created from completed work and payment reminders go out on schedule.
- Document generation: Quotes, contracts and reports are filled from your data in Google Docs and saved to the right folder.
- Employee onboarding: Accounts, equipment requests, training tasks and first-week emails are triggered from one form.
- Audit trail: Every step is logged with who did what and when, in a sheet your team can search.

From signed contract to kickoff call: One trigger starts every step. People only act where a decision is needed.
Steps: Contract signed (Trigger) → Client folder (Drive, templates) → Invoice schedule (In accounting) → Manager approval (One click) → Kickoff booked (Welcome email)

Deliverables:
- A process map showing every step, owner and tool
- Automations with approval steps where people need to decide
- Document templates connected to your data
- An audit log of every run
- Handover guide and 30 days of monitoring

Timeline:
- Map (Week 1): We walk through the process with the people who do it today and find where time is lost.
- Build (Weeks 2 to 4): We automate the steps in order, with approval points wherever a person must decide.
- Test (Week 4): We run real cases through the process and adjust it with your team.
- Launch (Weeks 5 to 6): We switch over in stages so nothing breaks during the change.

Tools we typically use for Business process automation: Google Drive, Gmail, Google Sheets, Apps Script, QuickBooks, ClickUp, Asana, n8n.

documents.title: Business process automation FAQ: Which processes are worth automating first?
documents.content:
Question about SalnetHub's Business process automation service: Which processes are worth automating first?
Answer: The ones that happen often, follow the same steps each time and involve copying data between tools. We help you rank them on the first call.

documents.title: Business process automation FAQ: What if our process has exceptions?
documents.content:
Question about SalnetHub's Business process automation service: What if our process has exceptions?
Answer: We build the normal path first and route exceptions to a person with all the context attached.

documents.title: Business process automation FAQ: Do we lose control over decisions?
documents.content:
Question about SalnetHub's Business process automation service: Do we lose control over decisions?
Answer: No. Anything that needs judgment stays with a person. The automation prepares the information and waits for their decision.

documents.title: Business process automation FAQ: Can you work with tools we built in-house?
documents.content:
Question about SalnetHub's Business process automation service: Can you work with tools we built in-house?
Answer: Often yes, if they have an API, a database we can read, or even a spreadsheet export.

documents.title: Task & workflow automation: overview and price
documents.content:
SalnetHub service: Task & workflow automation (Automation).
Remove the small repetitive tasks that eat your team's day, from data entry to reminders.
Win back hours every week. Data entry, reminders, file moves and status updates quietly eat your team's day. We automate them so your people can do the work they were hired for.

Small tasks, big cost:
- Death by copy and paste: Moving order details from email into a spreadsheet takes 3 minutes. Forty times a day, that is 2 hours.
- Reminders that rely on memory: Renewals, follow-ups and deadlines are tracked in someone's head or a sticky note.
- Constant status questions: People ask where things are because there is no automatic update when something changes.

Example: order handling for a wholesale supplier
Before: A coordinator copied about 40 orders a day from email into a spreadsheet and replied to each customer by hand.
After: Orders are added to Google Sheets as they arrive and customers get a confirmation automatically. That is about 6 hours a week back.

How you pay for Task & workflow automation: Pay from savings. Priced on time saved: your monthly fee is never more than 25% of what the work costs you today. Starts with a $250 pilot, refunded if it misses its target.

documents.title: Task & workflow automation: what is included and how it is delivered
documents.content:
What SalnetHub's Task & workflow automation service includes:
- Email to spreadsheet: Orders, receipts and requests in your inbox are read and added to Google Sheets as clean rows.
- Scheduled reminders: Renewals, deadlines and follow-ups trigger reminders to the right person at the right time.
- File handling: Attachments are renamed, filed into the right Drive folder and shared with the right people.
- Status updates: Customers and teammates get an automatic message when an order, ticket or task changes stage.
- Form processing: Form submissions become tasks, records and notifications without anyone retyping them.
- Apps Script tools: Custom buttons and menus inside Google Sheets and Docs for the jobs no off-the-shelf tool covers.

From inbox to done: Repetitive steps happen in seconds. Your team sees the result, not the busywork.
Steps: Order email (Arrives in Gmail) → Details read (Parsed automatically) → Sheet updated (New row added) → Team notified (Task created) → Customer updated (Status email sent)

Deliverables:
- A list of tasks ranked by hours saved per week
- Working automations for the top tasks
- Error alerts so you know if anything stops
- Handover guide and a recorded walkthrough
- 30 days of monitoring and fixes

Timeline:
- List (Days 1 to 2): We list the repetitive tasks and estimate the time each one costs.
- Build (Week 1): We automate the tasks with the biggest time savings first.
- Test (Week 2): We run the automations on real data alongside your team.
- Launch (Week 2): We switch them on and set up alerts in case anything fails.

Tools we typically use for Task & workflow automation: Gmail, Google Sheets, Google Drive, Apps Script, Google Calendar, Trello, Zapier, Make.

documents.title: Task & workflow automation FAQ: How small a task is worth automating?
documents.content:
Question about SalnetHub's Task & workflow automation service: How small a task is worth automating?
Answer: If it happens daily and follows the same steps, it is usually worth it. A 5-minute task done 10 times a day is 4 hours a week.

documents.title: Task & workflow automation FAQ: Make, Zapier or n8n?
documents.content:
Question about SalnetHub's Task & workflow automation service: Make, Zapier or n8n?
Answer: We pick the tool that fits your volume and budget. Zapier is simplest, Make handles complex logic at lower cost, and n8n suits high volumes.

documents.title: Task & workflow automation FAQ: What if an automation fails?
documents.content:
Question about SalnetHub's Task & workflow automation service: What if an automation fails?
Answer: You get an alert with the details, and we fix it. Monitoring is included in your monthly fee, so we usually see failures before you do.

documents.title: Task & workflow automation FAQ: Can we change the automations later?
documents.content:
Question about SalnetHub's Task & workflow automation service: Can we change the automations later?
Answer: Yes. We document how each one works so your team can make small changes, and we handle the bigger ones.

documents.title: AI chatbots for websites: overview and price
documents.content:
SalnetHub service: AI chatbots for websites (AI solutions).
A website chatbot that answers questions, guides visitors and books calls, trained on your content.
A website chatbot that knows your business. It answers visitor questions from your own content, points people to the right page, qualifies leads and books calls. A person takes over when needed.

Why visitors leave without a word:
- Questions go unanswered: Visitors have one question about price, timing or fit. If they cannot find the answer in 30 seconds, they leave.
- Forms feel like work: A contact form with 8 fields gets skipped. A conversation gets answered.
- After-hours traffic is wasted: Half your visits happen outside office hours, when nobody is there to reply.

Example: a chatbot for a training provider
Before: Most enquiries asked the same 10 questions about dates, prices and certificates, answered by email the next day.
After: The chatbot answers them instantly from the course catalogue and books a call when a company asks about group training.

How you pay for AI chatbots for websites: Pay per booking. Paid per booked appointment or qualified lead. No setup fee, nothing up front. Starts with a free 14-day pilot.

documents.title: AI chatbots for websites: what is included and how it is delivered
documents.content:

- Judgment calls pile up: Someone has to read each request, decide what it is and route it, dozens of times a day.

- Multi-step tasks: It works through a task across several tools, such as checking stock, drafting a quote and logging it.
- Approval checkpoints: Any action that sends, pays or deletes waits for a person to approve it.

How an agent handles a request: The agent prepares everything. A person approves before anything leaves the building.
Steps: Request arrives (Email or form) → Agent reads (Understands intent) → Gathers data (CRM, Sheets, Drive) → Needs approval (Person reviews) → Action done (Logged and sent)

- Launch (Week 6): We turn on approved actions step by step and review its work weekly.

- Least access: The agent only gets the permissions its job needs. It cannot reach anything else.
- Human approval: Sending, paying, deleting and other sensitive actions always wait for a person.

documents.title: SalnetHub pricing: you pay for results, not promises
documents.content:
You pay for results, not promises. Most agencies ask for thousands up front and hope it works. We do it the other way round: we work out what the problem costs you today, prove we can fix it in a 14-day pilot, and price our work below what you are already losing.

SalnetHub does not use a fixed price list. Every price is worked out from the client's own numbers, and is always below what the problem costs them today. All prices are in US dollars.

How pricing works:
1. We find the leak and put a number on it. On a free 20-minute call we ask a few simple questions: where your customers come from, how many slip away, and what each one is worth. Together we work out what the problem costs you every month. You confirm every number.
2. We prove it in a 14-day pilot. We fix one problem first, small and fast. You see the results in your own calendar, inbox or reports before you commit to anything bigger.
3. You pay based on what it brings you. Once it works, our price follows the result: per booked appointment, or a small share of the time we save you. Always less than the problem was costing you.

Third-party subscriptions and AI usage are paid directly to the providers, at cost. SalnetHub estimates them up front. For large one-off builds a fixed written quote is available after the pilot, if the client prefers.

documents.title: SalnetHub's two ways to charge: pay per result, or pay from what you save
documents.content:
SalnetHub charges in one of two ways, depending on the result the work brings:

Pay per result (Pay per booked appointment). Used for: Lead replies, chatbots, WhatsApp and SMS agents, call answering and old-lead reactivation. You pay for each booked appointment or qualified lead we deliver. No setup fee and nothing up front. If it does not book, you do not pay. How the price is set: We take what one lead costs you and how many of your leads actually book. That shows what a booked appointment really costs you today. We charge less than that. Includes: No setup fee; Free 14-day pilot; Every booking logged where you can see it.

Pay from what you save (Never more than 25% of the savings). Used for: Workflow automation, CRM, reporting and back-office processes. We measure how many hours a task takes your team each month and what those hours cost. Your monthly fee is never more than 25% of the cost we remove, so you keep at least 75%. How the price is set: The pilot is $250, refunded in full if it misses the target we agree at the start. After that you pay one monthly fee, with monitoring and fixes included. Includes: $250 pilot, refundable; Fee capped at 25% of savings; Monitoring and fixes included.

Pilots: every engagement starts with a 14-day pilot. Pay-per-result pilots are free. Automation pilots cost $250, refunded in full if the pilot misses the target agreed at the start. If the pilot does not deliver, the client owes nothing for the build.

documents.title: Pricing examples: what a booked appointment and manual work really cost
documents.content:
These are illustrations of how SalnetHub calculates a price. Real prices are set from the client's own numbers on the free call.

Booked appointments: a business pays $40 per lead and 1 in 4 leads books. $40 ÷ 0.25 = $160: that is what one booked appointment really costs them. SalnetHub would charge about $90 per booked appointment, and only when it books.

Manual work: 3 people × 6 hours a week × 4 weeks × $25 an hour = $1,800 a month. SalnetHub's monthly fee would be at most 25% of that saving, $450, so the client keeps the rest.

documents.content:
The SalnetHub home page has a calculator with two tabs.
Manual work: what copy-paste work costs per year: people × hours per week each × 48 working weeks × hourly rate. It assumes, conservatively, that automation removes half of that time, and shows SalnetHub's fee at most 25% of the saving.
Leads and bookings: what one lead costs ÷ the share of leads that book = what one booked appointment really costs. With SalnetHub the client pays less than that per booking, only when it books, with $0 up front. Default example: $40 per lead and 25% booking = $160 per booked appointment.

documents.title: How SalnetHub projects work: five steps
documents.content:
SalnetHub follows a clear process with results-based pricing, weekly updates and nothing installed on your side. Five steps, from first call to a system that keeps running. Each step ends with something concrete you can see, check and keep.

1. Discover: We learn how the work happens today. A 20-minute call, then a closer look at your tools and the people who use them. We find where time is lost and agree on the first workflow worth automating. Output: A clear target and a 14-day pilot plan.
2. Build: We build in a safe copy of your setup. Automations are built and tested away from live data. You see progress every week, in plain language, with nothing to install. Output: Working automations in a test setup.
3. Test: We run real examples end to end. Your team pushes real cases through every path, including the odd ones. We fix every issue before anything touches live data. Output: A signed-off test checklist.
4. Hand over: We launch and teach your team. We switch on in stages, watch the first days closely, and leave a written guide plus a recorded walkthrough. Output: Documentation your team can use.
5. Support: We keep it running. Tools change their APIs and processes evolve. Your monthly fee includes monitoring and fixes, and we add new builds when they pay for themselves. Output: Monthly health report.
